author: SnowSX3
body:
Instagram Application

Minecraft Username: SnowSX3

Discord ID: SnowSX3#6425

In 1 or 2 sentences, tell me who you are: SnowSX3, former 3x Moderator; 2x Referee and Mentor for Avicus.  

What is your Instagram account? Private and I'd like to keep it that way, 

although Administrator {tag=bff56e079469477281be84fc627ea113} and Senior Social Media member {tag=0af038412894434ca4be965b317244e8} both have access to it if the staff team needs proof/ justification.

Have you ever used Instagram to market something? No, although have an idea on how to do it based off friends using Insta to market their own professional products. 

However, this is new grounds for me and I am willing to learn and help this server in any way I can.

Have you ever marketed something using Instagram before? You said the same question twice xD 

What changes would you like to see made on the Instagram team? I would like to increase the activity of it by increasing general posting and promoting user activity. Perhaps using Reddit to add some eyes to the page as well.

How active are you/how is your work ethnic? I don't know what a work ethnic is.

However, I do believe my work ethic is above the standard.


As a Moderator, I've had to carry the Australian Timezone by myself for long periods of time. 

I've also consistently mentored many former and current staff members. 

I believe I am consistent, efficient and am professional with my work. 

After a long hiatus, we are finally bringing back our official Instagram account. If you have a passion for advertising on the Instagram platform, this will be perfect for creating a brand for Avicus on the platform. I look forward to working with the Social Media team should the opportunity present itself. Thank you.
